name: Unlock Skill Listing Description Limit
description: Raises the hard-coded per-skill description character cap used when building the model-facing Agent Skills listing. In 2.1.158 the default skillListingMaxDescChars (minified const Ix5) is 1536 (was MAX_LISTING_DESC_CHARS=250 in the 2.1.88 source); the SkillTool listing truncates each skill's `description - whenToUse` to this many chars before the model sees it. This patch swaps the default 1536 -> 9999 (same length, 4 digits) so fuller skill descriptions reach the model and skills match more reliably. Honors the runtime settings override path (skillListingMaxDescChars) and SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET; only the hard-coded fallback default is changed.

provenance.author: huybuidac
provenance.derived_by: anchored against pristine 2.1.158 using 2.1.88 source ref (tools/SkillTool/prompt.ts MAX_LISTING_DESC_CHARS); upstream repo has no unlock-limits-skills.md, so the limit was identified from source and located in the binary

operations.rationale: Ix5 holds the default skillListingMaxDescChars (per-skill description char cap for the Agent Skills listing the model sees). Source 2.1.88 had MAX_LISTING_DESC_CHARS=250; 2.1.158 bumped the default to 1536 and made it settings-overridable. We bump the hard-coded fallback default 1536 -> 9999 (4 ASCII digits, same length). The preceding `=200000,<ident>=` (bx5 = default char budget) is a unique landmark; raw 1536 appears 16x in the binary but the full anchor matches exactly once. Backreferences preserve churned minified identifiers.
